title: Sri Lanka women face Bangladesh in Asia Cup group B clash
byline: Sri Lanka Women will look to maintain their winning run when they take on Bangladesh Women in the 10th match of the Women’s Asia Cup 2026 Group B at the Dubai International Cricket Stadium on September 6.

title: Pathirage makes Diamond League history
byline: Sri Lanka’s Rumesh Tharanga Pathirage made history by becoming the country’s first Diamond League champion, winning the men’s javelin title with a best throw of 89.04 metres at the Diamond League Final in Brussels on Saturday night.

title: 41 arrested following raid on Facebook party in Teldeniya
byline: Police have arrested 36 male and five female suspects following a raid on a Facebook party held in the Victoria area of Teldeniya. The operation was carried out by a team of officers from the Teldeniya Police Station based on a tip-off.
